summary: Repair noVNC desktop application launch sequence

delivery.outcome: Launch each XFCE application only after its command has been resolved, so the recorded demo actually edits and saves its document and opens Firefox.
nonGoals: No remote container shell dependency in the demo; no unrelated application changes.

architecture.decision: Centralize noVNC keyboard launches, clear stale input and allow XFCE command and GTK save-path resolution before Enter. Display the saved document locally in Firefox and verify the complete sequence in an opt-in disposable-container e2e test.
architecture.rollback: Revert the demo commit; existing recordings are preserved.

commands: docker build -t nlp2cmd-novnc-test docker/novnc && NLP2CMD_NOVNC_TEST_IMAGE=nlp2cmd-novnc-test python3 -m pytest -m e2e tests/unit/test_novnc_demo.py::test_full_desktop_demo_in_disposable_container
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_novnc_demo.py tests/unit/test_media_recorder.py tests/unit/test_executors.py
